notes.title: Costumes Update
notes.content:
Following the haloween tradition this year, we have added unlockable costumes for all characters. These costumes can simply be unlocked with the stars you have aquired through completing levels. More costumes will be added over time, so stay tuned.

Aside from costumes, we also did some bug fixes, some level adjustments and updated the UI layout.

Lastly, we would like to say happy haloween, guys!
